actions.description: Query this owner's consented PA context for saved delivery destinations. No user address, country or merchant is prefilled in the task scope.
Search the sandbox merchant directory using your chosen business query. Discovery establishes candidates, never purchase authority.
Query one discovered merchant for a product matching your query, including its source variant, pricing and customs product facts.
Query a selected product's sellable capacity for the requested quantity by warehouse. This does not reserve inventory.
Query shipping choices for a source product, evidenced quantity and authorized destination. Discover actual dispatch countries, package groups and conditional delivery promises.

Query synthetic import eligibility, required facts and tax responsibility for your chosen fulfillment option. Domestic and international routes return distinct evidence; never infer rules or tax rates.
Request an exact source quote for your selected inventory, destination, shipping and customs evidence. Evaluate its buyer charges, responsibilities and promises before proceeding.
Create a sandbox draft cart for the selected product and quantity. Requires a specific sandbox permit, creates no inventory reservation, order or payment.
Read the current state of an original owned cart, including after its previous observation expired. Its old identity is not new execution authority.
Replace the sandbox cart contents at its exact observed version. This invalidates downstream selections; no order or inventory reservation is implied.
Cancel this exact sandbox draft cart. Order cancellation is a different operation.
Create a sandbox checkout from an independently evaluated firm quote, optionally using a matching cart. The exact source terms are pinned; no order or payment occurs.

Submit the exact independently validated sandbox checkout with separate order and simulated payment authority. Read the original order and payment independently afterwards; never repeat an unknown submission.

Submit the exact evaluated sandbox checkout as an unpaid order for the configured Stripe test program. Order authority has zero payment cost; a separate exact payment permit is required later. Retains all goods, quote and shipping gates.
Independently read the original sandbox order and compare its fixed items, destination and cost allocation.
Read the original order's separate simulated payment receipt. Order confirmation alone proves no payment settlement.
Read original sandbox shipment events with package quantities and destination identity. A shipping event or fulfilled counter does not prove arrival.
Create one unconfirmed Stripe test PaymentIntent for the independently read unpaid sandbox order. Needs an exact zero-cost change permit; no charge occurs.

Confirm the original PaymentIntent using a scope-limited shared payment token from the Stripe sandbox test helper. Needs an exact payment permit bound to the order, amount and configured account. No live key or user wallet is supported.
Independently GET the original Stripe test PaymentIntent and expanded charge. Verify account, order binding, amount, currency, capture and refunds; never infer settlement or fulfillment.
Read source service availability and exact terms. Choose a source offer yourself; a listed slot grants no booking or payment authority.
Create one unpaid sandbox booking for the evaluated source offer. Requires exact reservation authority with zero payment spend. Never pays or confirms service delivery.
Independently read the original provider booking, fixed terms and confirmation status. Can use an expired observation for identity only.
Independently read the provider payment linked to the original booking. A PA report is only a notification; it cannot supply these facts.

After independently reading both the booking and its unpaid payment state, publish exact terms to the PA and pause. PA uses its own wallet directly with the provider. This local action never issues payment credentials or charges money.
Pause on the same payment request after independently reading unresolved payment or booking status. Preserve the original identity and tell the PA to query, not pay again.

Search public product observations for one allowed merchant using your chosen query and result limit. Returns every matching merchant variant in the bounded response. No detail or merchant call is implied.
Read current global detail for one variant already evidenced in an owned observation. Choose the variant explicitly; this action makes one detail call.
Read and validate an allowed merchant's UCP catalog endpoint and supported read capabilities. Returns a CatalogEndpoint for later merchant reads, with no catalog lookup.

Read the explicitly selected variant IDs at a previously discovered merchant endpoint. IDs must be present in your referenced observation or explicitly supplied by the requester. Returns exact variant facts even if they differ from an earlier observation; you decide what to do next.

Read the owner's address book once. Returns only a count to the model. To let the owner choose, issue a clarify decision with [[saved_addresses]]; the host displays private choices only in the owned task response.

Read one saved address's contact detail once. Supply an exact user-supplied address name or previously displayed choice label and its sender/recipient role. The host resolves it uniquely within the referenced current book; model-invented or ambiguous choices are rejected. No book or quote call is implied.

Read one fee preview for the current Parcel and selected DeliveryRoute references, with two evidenced, user-selected address details. Read their owned relationships first. Parcel facts and the current request service are materialized from Ontology; do not restate them as action arguments. The private connector materializes contacts. This action does not read the book or details and cannot create orders or payments.
Prepare a local test checkout session; no order or payment. Requires a separate sandbox dispatch permit.
Confirm the exact local test checkout. Both order and payment effects require authorization; this proposal never grants it.
